name: io.github.MDPuneethReddy/cryoem-files-mcp
title: Cryo-EM Files
description: Inspect, validate and convert cryo-EM files: MRC, TIFF/EER movies, gain references, STAR, mdoc.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: Folder the tools may read. Required: the server will not start without it. Repeat for several folders.

environmentVariables.name: CRYOEM_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to --root: allowed folders separated by ':' (';' on Windows). Ignored when --root is given.

environmentVariables.name: CRYOEM_MCP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds before a single tool call is abandoned with an error (default 300). --timeout overrides it.
